items.quote: I have been told by the word of the Lord: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’
items.contrast: The reader must distinguish the prophet’s invitation from the Lord’s prohibition, which is the man’s reason for refusing.
items.reason: The man explicitly grounds his refusal in the command he received from the Lord. The prophet’s invitation prompted the refusal but did not explain why he refused.
